t: This is the Duke of York's Headquarters in Chelsea. It was declared a listed building at Grade II* in 1969, for its outstanding historic and architectural interest. It was designed by John Sanders, who lived from 1768 to 1826. He was the first pupil taken on by Sir John Soane, starting on 1 September 1784. Sanders was born in the City of London, the son of a tallow chandler.
